## [1.5.1](https://github.com/sabbirdj/viper-patches/compare/v1.5.0...v1.5.1) (2026-11-12)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* correct parameter register in Bangladesh VPN H/I tier patches ([ffade23](https://github.com/sabbirdj/viper-patches/commit/ffade23955e300cfd76ae4bc8c6d2363e53c3d35))

patches.name: Spoof installer source (Play Store)
patches.description: Makes Bangladesh VPN appear installed from Google Play (com.android.vending) so a manually installed build does not hit 'not installed from Play Store' paths. Same logic as the Morphe universal 'Change installer source' patch. Verified on 67.26.

patches.name: Unlock VIP
patches.description: Unlocks Bangladesh VPN VIP by forcing the local subscription tier to FULL in every place that reads it: the tier predicates (H/I), the Play Billing purchase callback, the tier deriver, and the persisted tier default. VIP servers connect and the premium section activates. No server change needed. Verified on 67.26.

patches.name: Remove ads (APKS Installer)
patches.description: Disables all ads by forcing the master ads flag MyApplication.m to false and making the ad initializer a no-op. Verified on APKS Installer 2.8-Google.

patches.name: Unlock SAI Premium
patches.description: Activates SAI Premium by forcing the local entitlement check to true in all three places that read it (ck0, fk0, dk0). Verified on SAI 2.4.3.

patches.name: MicroG RE Google Sign-In
patches.description: Redirects Google Sign-In to MicroG RE (app.revanced.android.gms): forces normal sign-in mode, rewrites the sign-in action/package, and drops the unused ID-token request. Pair with the 'MicroG signature spoof' manifest patch or login fails with error 8. Verified on Shohay 2.1.1.

patches.name: MicroG signature spoof
patches.description: Adds the original Play signature (SHA-1) as the app.revanced.android.gms.SPOOFED_PACKAGE_SIGNATURE manifest meta-data, so MicroG RE sends the original signature to Google during sign-in and the re-signed app is accepted. Required for the 'MicroG RE Google Sign-In' patch. Verified on Shohay 2.1.1.

patches.name: Spoof installer source (Play Store)
patches.description: Makes Shohay appear installed from Google Play (com.android.vending) so a manually installed build does not hit 'not installed from Play Store' paths. Same logic as the Morphe universal 'Change installer source' patch. Verified on Shohay 2.1.1.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks all weekly premium videos by making SubscribedWeeksDeriver return every week (1-42) as subscribed with 1000 days remaining. The premium gate is evaluated locally from this result, so no server change is needed. Verified on Shohay 2.1.1.
